In this petition, petitioner seeks the following reliefs;
"a) Quash the entire proceedings in S.C.No.211/2024 of Cr.No.148/2023 of Electronic City Police for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2), 417, 312,
324, 323, 504, 506 of IPC pending on the file of the VI Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru Rural District at Bengaluru.
b) Pass such other orders as this Hon'ble Court deem fit in the facts and circumstances of the case and in the ends of justice."
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent No.1-State and learned counsel for respondent No.2 and perused the record.
3.

In this petition, petitioner seeks the following reliefs;
"a) Quash the entire proceedings in S.C.No.211/2024 of Cr.No.148/2023 of Electronic City Police for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2), 417, 312,
324, 323, 504, 506 of IPC pending on the file of the VI Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru Rural District at Bengaluru.
b) Pass such other orders as this Hon'ble Court deem fit in the facts and circumstances of the case and in the ends of justice."
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent No.1-State and learned counsel for respondent No.2 and perused the record.
3.
A perusal of the material on record will indicate that pursuant to the complaint dated 06.07.2023 filed by NC: 2025:KHC:18926 HC-KAR respondent No.2 against the petitioner for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2), 417, 312, 324, 323, 504, 506 of IPC, the impugned proceedings in S.C.No.211/2024 are pending before the trial Court, which are assailed in the present petition.

In this context, it is relevant to state that consensual sexual relationship arising out of false promise to marry would not attract the offence punishable under Section 376 of IPC as held by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the following three judgments;
(i) Pramod Suryabhan Pawar vs. The State of Maharashtra and another1;
(ii) Lallu Yadev vs. State of Uttar Pradesh2; and (iii) Mahesh Damu Khare vs. State of Maharashtra and another.3 5.

5. In the result, the following;
(i) The petition is allowed.
